instructions: Work through as many missions as you like; each takes 2-4 minutes.
Ask the question exactly as written first; then feel free to rephrase it the way you would at work.
Rate each answer: was it correct, were the references the right ones, and would you rely on it?
If you know the correct notification/circular/section, type it in — that is the most valuable feedback.
Please also ask at least 5 real questions from your own practice (track G).
tracks: A. Is this notification still in force?
C. Everyday GST questions (from your own past queries)
F. Trick questions (it should refuse or say "not found")

missions.track: A. Is this notification still in force?
missions.title: Amendment history of a GST notification
missions.question: Has Notification No. 35/2020-Central Tax been amended? Which notifications amended it and what did the latest one change?
good_answer: Amended by 55/2020-Central Tax (27.06.2020)
Further amended by 65/2020-Central Tax, extending the due date for compliance under Section 171 to 30.11.2020
Quotes the amending notification text
missions.why: Core product promise: show the chain behind a notification.

missions.track: A. Is this notification still in force?
missions.title: Is an anti-dumping notification still valid?
missions.question: Is Notification No. 56/2016-Customs (ADD) still in force?
good_answer: No — superseded by Notification 51/2017-Customs
51/2017-Customs also rescinded 08/2013-Customs (ADD)
Quotes the supersession text
missions.why: A superseded notification cited as live is the costliest mistake a practitioner can make.

missions.track: A. Is this notification still in force?
missions.title: Amendments to the main customs exemption notification
missions.question: Which notifications amended Notification No. 50/2017-Customs in September 2021, and on what dates?
good_answer: 42/2021-Customs dated 10.09.2021
44/2021-Customs dated 17.09.2021
missions.why: 50/2017-Customs is the most-amended exemption notification; importers must know its current state.

missions.track: A. Is this notification still in force?
missions.title: Relying on an old excise notification
missions.question: Can I still rely on Notification No. 19/2000-Central Excise for my exemption claim?
good_answer: It was rescinded by Notification 7/2001-CE dated 01.03.2001
Quotes the rescission
missions.why: Tests "rescinded" detection and a clear warning.

missions.track: A. Is this notification still in force?
missions.title: Last amendment before a given notification
missions.question: What was the last notification that amended the principal notification No. 21/2019-Central Tax (GSTR-4 filing) before Notification 10/2021-Central Tax, and when was it issued?
good_answer: 64/2020-Central Tax dated 31.08.2020
Quotes the note in 10/2021-Central Tax
missions.why: "As amended up to date X" is the question courts now expect to be verified.

missions.track: A. Is this notification still in force?
missions.title: Tracing a long amendment chain
missions.question: List the notifications that amended Notification No. 31/86-Customs over the years.
good_answer: Presents them in date order
missions.why: Stress test for multi-step chains.

missions.track: A. Is this notification still in force?
missions.title: Rate change on a date
missions.question: What was the GST rate change for mobile phones (HSN 8517.12) effective from April 1, 2020?
good_answer: Cites notification(s): 03/2020-CT(R); 01/2017-CT(R)
Conclusion mentions: 18%, increased from 12%
missions.why: Rate "as on a date" questions are the everyday version of the chain problem.

missions.track: B. Customs for importers & exporters
missions.title: Concessional rate under 50/2017-Customs
missions.question: What is the concessional IGST rate for rough precious stones imported under Notification 50/2017-Cus, and what happens to BCD?
good_answer: Cites notification(s): 50/2017-Cus; GST rate schedule notification (01/2017-IT(R) as amended)
Conclusion mentions: 0.25%, nil BCD, rough stones
missions.why: Importer everyday question with a notification condition.

missions.track: B. Customs for importers & exporters
missions.title: Social Welfare Surcharge on IGST
missions.question: When calculating the total customs duty on imported goods, is the Social Welfare Surcharge (SWS) levied on the IGST component?
good_answer: Cites: Section 3(7) Customs Tariff Act; Chapter VI of Finance Act 2018
Conclusion mentions: no, SWS on BCD, not on IGST, not on compensation cess
missions.why: Common duty-computation confusion.

missions.track: B. Customs for importers & exporters
missions.title: Warehousing period
missions.question: An importer deposits raw materials (non-capital goods) into a public customs bonded warehouse. Under Section 61, what is the standard initial period these goods can remain warehoused, and can it be extended?
good_answer: Cites: Section 61 Customs Act
Conclusion mentions: one year, extended by the Principal Commissioner, Commissioner of Customs, sufficient cause
missions.why: Plain-language procedure question.

missions.track: B. Customs for importers & exporters
missions.title: Re-export of a defective machine
missions.question: An importer pays duty on a specialized machine, but it turns out to be incompatible with their systems. They re-export it back to the supplier 3 months later without ever putting it to use. What percentage of duty drawback can they claim, and under what section?
good_answer: Cites: Section 74 Customs Act
Conclusion mentions: Section 74, 98 per cent, imported goods exported, without use
missions.why: Refund/drawback question SMEs ask.

missions.track: B. Customs for importers & exporters
missions.title: Rejected transaction value
missions.question: If the proper officer rejects the declared transaction value of imported goods under Rule 12 of the Customs Valuation Rules, 2007, what is the mandatory sequence of rules to determine the value?
good_answer: Cites: Section 14 Customs Act
Conclusion mentions: sequential application, identical goods, similar goods, deductive value, computed value, residual method
missions.why: Valuation-rule sequence.

missions.track: B. Customs for importers & exporters
missions.title: Related-party imports (SVB)
missions.question: What is the role of the Special Valuation Branch (SVB) in customs?
good_answer: Cites notification(s): Circular 5/2016-Customs
Conclusion mentions: related party, transfer pricing, valuation, SVB, investigation
missions.why: Broker-level question.

missions.track: C. Everyday GST questions (from your own past queries)
missions.title: Return due date
missions.question: When is GSTR-3B due?
good_answer: States the due date and cites the rule/notification that sets it
Mentions state-wise staggered dates (20th/22nd/24th) if applicable, or asks for the taxpayer type
missions.why: Short, common question — should be fast and precise.

missions.track: C. Everyday GST questions (from your own past queries)
missions.title: ITC time limit
missions.question: What is the time limit for claiming ITC under Section 16(4)?
good_answer: Cites Section 16(4) CGST Act verbatim
30 November following the end of the financial year (post-2022 amendment) or annual return, whichever is earlier
missions.why: Classic "as amended" trap: the date changed in 2022.

missions.track: C. Everyday GST questions (from your own past queries)
missions.title: Rate lookup
missions.question: What is the GST rate on branded rice?
good_answer: Explains the pre-packaged and labelled rule (5%) vs loose (nil)
Cites the rate notification and its amendment
missions.why: Your earlier run said the rate was "not directly" found — a good regression check.

missions.track: C. Everyday GST questions (from your own past queries)
missions.title: Blocked credit on a car
missions.question: Can a registered taxpayer claim ITC on GST paid for the purchase of a motor car (seating capacity 5) used for business?
good_answer: Cites: 17(5)(a) CGST
Conclusion mentions: blocked, 17(5), not eligible
missions.why: Blocked-credit basics.

missions.track: C. Everyday GST questions (from your own past queries)
missions.title: Reverse charge on legal services
missions.question: A registered company pays a sole-proprietor advocate for legal services. Who is liable to pay GST?
good_answer: Cites: 9(3) CGST
Cites notification(s): 13/2017-Central Tax (Rate)
Conclusion mentions: reverse charge, recipient, RCM, company
missions.why: RCM notification citation.

missions.track: D. Real business scenarios
missions.title: Undervaluation by a related-party supplier
missions.question: An importer brings in goods from a related party supplier in Germany. The customs authorities suspect undervaluation. Explain the procedure under the Customs Valuation Rules, 2007, specifically referring to Rule 3(3) regarding related party transactions and the role of the Special Valuation Branch (SVB) as per Circular 5/2016-Cus.
good_answer: Cites: Section 14 Customs Act
Cites notification(s): Circular 5/2016-Cus
Conclusion mentions: related party, transaction value accepted if relationship didn't influence price, SVB investigation, extra duty deposit
missions.why: Long scenario — where retrieval used to fail.

missions.track: D. Real business scenarios
missions.title: IGST drawback on immediate re-export
missions.question: An importer pays IGST on imported goods and then immediately re-exports them without putting them to use. Can they claim duty drawback under Section 74 of the Customs Act for the IGST paid? Contrast this with the availability of ITC under the CGST Act.
good_answer: Cites: Section 74 Customs Act; Section 16 CGST Act
Conclusion mentions: no drawback for IGST, drawback only for BCD, claim ITC under GST
missions.why: Multi-provision reasoning.

missions.track: D. Real business scenarios
missions.title: Plant quarantine on a mixed consignment
missions.question: GreenRoots Horticulture Pvt Ltd (GSTIN 29AABCG1234F1ZX), based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, imports a consignment of 1,200 kgs of sphagnum moss and 800 kgs of Perlite (declared for agricultural use) arriving at New Delhi's IGI Airport in March 2025. The company's customs broker insists that two separate Plant Quarantine Import Permits are required. Which authority issues the permit for each commodity at this port, what fee applies to the sphagnum moss, and does the fumigation supervision obligation apply to both?
good_answer: Identifies the Plant Quarantine (Regulation of Import into India) Order schedule entries
Names the permit-issuing authority per commodity
Quotes the fee and fumigation conditions
missions.why: Allied-law scenario an importer would really ask.

missions.track: D. Real business scenarios
missions.title: Hearing timeline in an excise SCN (known miss)
missions.question: Prakash & Associates, a Cost Accounting firm in Chennai, represents Suvarna Steels Pvt Ltd, which received a Show Cause Notice for irregular CENVAT credit of Rs 4.5 crore under Section 11A(4) of the Central Excise Act citing wilful suppression. Within what time must a personal hearing be granted after the demand notice if the assessee asks for one?
good_answer: Cites the provision on personal hearing / adjournments (Section 33A or the relevant Appeals rules/circular)
Says clearly if the CBIC documents do not fix a hard timeline
missions.why: One of the questions the old system could not find; tells us if the new search helps.
